title: Size of the program circuit
statement: For any natural numbers $n,m,w$, any type of instruction kinds with a designated default, any function assigning to each kind a Boolean-list function, any program of instructions, and any indices $i,j$, the size of the circuit built from the program with output indices $i,j$ equals $n+2$ plus the sum, over the instructions in the program, of the widths of the gadgets associated to their kinds.
